notes.title: $1.99 Forever!
notes.notes: Blue Sheep has had some minor bug fixes as well as a price drop to $1.99. Blue Sheep was built by a two man team and was the programmers first game. Due to this we recognize that some users are encountering some issues. We want everyone to be able to enjoy the game and feel the price paid was fair. Thanks everyone so much for your feedback!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Blue Sheep
notes.notes:
Blue Sheep is Now Available on Steam!

Blue sheep is a Platformer Adventure set in a strange world, plagued by the physical manifestation of misery, known as the Beast. Play as the Outsider, experiencing the memories of a warrior who once opposed the Beast.
